from collections import deque, Counter

def basic_enclosure_fill(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    vals = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    background = max(vals, key=vals.get)
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    q = deque()
    
    # Start from border
    for r in range(h):
        for c in (0, w-1):
            if g[r][c] == background and not seen[r][c]:
                seen[r][c] = True
                q.append((r, c))
    for c in range(w):
        for r in (0, h-1):
            if g[r][c] == background and not seen[r][c]:
                seen[r][c] = True
                q.append((r, c))

            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and g[nr][nc] == background and not seen[nr][nc]:
